approach: Modify the read_definition_file method to iterate through original file lines (including empties) instead of pre-filtering whitespace-only lines away. For each original line, compute its logical position and maintain offset counters to properly translate between file line numbers and effective content line numbers for error reporting.
hypothesis: When reading the definition file, we currently skip whitespace-only lines entirely before processing content. To report accurate line numbers in error messages, we need to process ALL lines including empty ones, then track both actual line number and processed logical line positions separately.
